experienceData.name: Unizoy
experienceData.title: Software Development Engineer
description: Own the embeddable AI chat widget behind Converzoy, Unizoy's AI sales-agent platform — a Next.js app bundled by Rollup into a single drop-in embed script, with SSE-streamed responses, product-card carousels, an in-chat meeting scheduler, and proactive pop-ups triggered by scroll depth and dwell time. Live across 5+ client sites at 99.99% uptime, with one client seeing a 40% lift in conversions.

Built the WhatsApp Business Cloud API integration for the platform: per-app webhooks with signature verification, workflow invocation by app, typing indicators and read receipts, backed by a schema migration and console UI for per-tenant configuration.
Deployed and customized the self-hosted Dify-based platform on AWS with Docker and CI/CD, and added multi-tenant usage metering so new client apps launch provisioned and ready to use.
Engineered a custom RAG pipeline powering a persona chatbot that replies in a creator's distinct tone, trained on 250+ videos (~125 hrs) of YouTube content, serving 200+ daily active users.
Mentor 3–4 interns and drive cross-functional collaboration with designers and product managers, delivering 10+ project milestones at a 95% on-time rate.

experienceData.name: Unizoy
experienceData.title: Full Stack Developer (Intern)
description: Developed and optimized a full-stack (React + NestJS) trader management platform — implemented frontend UI from Figma designs and reduced backend API latency from 900ms+ to under 200ms through query optimization and efficient data handling.

Built the brokerage accounting reporting suite end to end: P&L, margin, interest and account-value reports with per-UCC filtering, family-scoped views and Excel/CSV exports, plus an incremental precompute engine that recomputes only the rows affected by each upload.

Hardened the trading-data ingestion path — per-user file-upload validation with a surfaced error drawer, duplicate-entry guards keyed on UCC pairs, and corrected NSE/BSE/MCX exchange identifier handling with per-user exchange preferences.
Shipped e-commerce features for the AI chat widget: product-card carousels and variant selection rendered from tool responses, in-chat add-to-cart, and a Shopify product-tools plugin backing them.

Built the in-chat meeting scheduler (calendar slot UI, slot start/end handling, conversation-context-aware booking) and fixed multi-turn context by threading parent_message_id through the chat payload.
Integrated WhatsApp webhooks into the platform and contributed to Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbots for Unizoy's AI platform.
